preconditions.description: The dimensions of the matrix and the number of copies are within specified bounds.
There are exactly k+1 pictures provided.

preconditions.expression: all(len(pic) == n for pic in pictures)
preconditions.description: Each picture has exactly n rows.

preconditions.expression: all(all(c in '01' for c in row) for pic in pictures for row in pic)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the pictures contains either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.description: The index of the initial picture is between 1 and k+1.
The number of operations is between 0 and k * n * m.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= op[1] <= k + 1 for op in operations if op[0] == 2)
postconditions.description: Each copy operation refers to a valid picture index.

postconditions.expression: all(2 <= op[1] <= n - 1 and 2 <= op[2] <= m - 1 for op in operations if op[0] == 1)
postconditions.description: Each recolor operation targets a valid cell within the matrix.
Applying the operations to the initial picture reproduces the given pictures.
